Name of player being reported: Blackware
Rule broken: Do not swear
Evidence: Open the log file I added to this post. The entire swearing / conversation starts when he is saying "אויב ישראלי, אתם המטרה היחידה והאויב היחיד, אני גדלתי על זה, וא תמיד יהיה האויב שלי ושלום מעולם לא ד" (Hebrew for "Israeli enemy, you are the only target and the only enemy, I grew up on that, you will always be my enemy and peace never d"). It starts at 12:47:43 and ends at the bottom of the file. The real conversation when I started responding to his curses starts at 13:02:08. Till then he was just swearing randomly about Israelis and Jews. I am sorry that I do not have a screenshot of that, but I only have a log file which is found under the AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/logs folder, and I pasted it here.
Anything else you would like to add?: I cannot stand being sweared at and reading such racist things about Jews or Israelis. I know I got banned for getting back at him, but he should get banned either for saying such things. Thank you for reading this and I hope you take care of him,
mr_pilot.

Have a nice day.

Koja.
